cases.provenance: A user reported this defect after the reviewed pull request, and a later fix repaired it.
cases.summary: Message bar text shouldn't be computed based on byte length
cases.description: There are some string length checks for the message bar which use the byte length (see [here](https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty/blob/62c300c14ce7a96373e0094763e9fd035b6b9b6d/alacritty/src/display.rs#L419)). Generally I don't think unicode and fullwidth characters have been considered much for the message bar. However since it's possible for user config to show up inside the message bar, it's possible to have these unicode symbols present here.

evidence.eventual_fix_title: Fix handling of Unicode characters in Message bar
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix handling of Unicode characters in Message bar

When formating text for displaying in Message bar, allacritty was using the byte
length of the text instead of character length; this generated unnecessary blank
space at the end of lines.

Fixes #4250.
